original.statement: The Redis provider's tls.caOptional configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-9f184d231baf] says the Redis provider's `tls.caOptional` option was removed in v3. Its example shows the option set in three ways: the static file key providers.redis.tls.caOptional (YAML/TOML) and the CLI flag --providers.redis.tls.caOptional. The fix it gives is to remove the option. So the exposed environments are those that set this key or this flag, which is exactly the proposed any[values-key set, cli-flag set] condition. It is neither broader nor narrower than what the evidence supports.
